title: Create Aeronautics Ultimate
description: This modpack includes a nice combination of mods from Create Ultimate (including Aeronautics) and Homestead.
body:
This is a custom modpack containing many popular Create Mods concentrated on Create Aeronautics, along with many supporting mods that revamp world generation, optimize performance, and add quality of life features. It aims to balance the typical modded experience with mods carefully chosen and tested for compatibility with Create Aeronuatics.

It is recommended to also install the FTB suite in addition to this modpack.
**
Icons and assets used for this modpack project are derivative works based on the Create Aeronautics mod. All credit for the original assets goes to the Simulated team**
